name: feat.iruxi-armaments.name
editNote: Accepted: every sentence and every prerequisite of the record was compared with the book and found (the few the comparison could not match were a page break or a page reference in the middle of a sentence, or 'three' written as '3'). The reports are informational: bullet lists kept as dash lines; the structured source's closing 'leads to' list dropped as a reverse index the book does not print; a prerequisite that is a heritage, subclass or class feature kept as prose; a class of a book that is not imported left out of the class trait; a link to a rules page the dataset does not model kept as its label. For the archetype feats that embed an action, that action is its own record.
